name: Customer support triage

parameters.content:
## Customer support triage
Email → AI category, priority and reply draft → helpdesk ticket.

**Guards:** safety and legal wording → urgent and a person, whatever the model says · instructions inside an email → a person · drafts that promise refunds or replacements → a person · complaints, warranty and wholesale always go to a person.

**AI off:** keyword baseline.

nodes.name: Load sample data
nodes.notes: Invented, labelled items served by the mock services

nodes.name: Apply support rules
nodes.notes: Safety and legal words always go to a person

nodes.name: AI switched on?
nodes.notes: Off: the rule-based path handles everything

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ sample_id: $json.sample_id, from: $json.from, subject: $json.subject, text: $json.text, category: $json.category, priority: $json.priority, needs_person: $json.needs_person, queue: $json.queue, status: $json.status, reason: $json.reason, reply_draft: $json.reply_draft, guard_hits: $json.guard_hits, decided_by: $json.decided_by }) }}

nodes.name: Create helpdesk ticket
nodes.notes: The draft is stored; nothing is sent

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: 'URGENT ticket ' + $json.id + ' from ' + $json.from + ': ' + $json.subject + ' (' + ($json.guard_hits.join(', ') || $json.category) + '). Please call the customer today.' }) }}

description: Classifies support emails, sets a priority and drafts a reply for a person to check. Safety, legal and manipulation wording always goes to a person. Never emails a customer itself.
